However, if you would like to guarantee and secure the apartment for 3 or 6 months, kindly let us know the required duration, and we will be happy to share the full quotation with you.

To confirm and secure a 3-month or 6-month booking, the first month’s rent, last month’s rent, and refundable security deposit are required to be paid in advance.

But if you choose to extend your stay on a month-to-month basis, the rates will be subject to availability and current market rates, and the rates may increase based on market conditions.
